# Toy guards

Generated by the guard test (`go test -run TestGuards -update`); do not edit.

A command is applied only if no guard on its action refuses it; a refused one changes nothing and offers the remedies.

## Guards

| guard | checks | why | keeps | remedies |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| issued-fixes-the-fee | bill.setFee, bill.delete | An issued invoice says what is owed | issued-never-changes | bill.cancel; not built yet: bill.creditNote |
| received-fixes-the-fee | bill.setFee | Money received settled the fee as it was | received-matches-fee | bill.undoPayment |
| notes-later | bill.note | Notes are written after the visit | policy: notes are written once it has started | none: it waits for the visit to start |

## By action

| action | guards, in the order they refuse |
|---|---|
| bill.delete | issued-fixes-the-fee |
| bill.note | notes-later |
| bill.setFee | issued-fixes-the-fee, received-fixes-the-fee |
